note: This task's scope is source-only: a new opt-in hosted spec, an optional workflow scope, and a local policy test. No deployment, no hosted acceptance run, and no live BFF/FE writes were performed by this task. Hosted acceptance (a real workflow_dispatch run against the live Pantheon dev deployment with the workshop_persistence_only input) is a separate, later step gated on this PR merging and is explicitly out of scope here per the task brief. This revision repairs five defects an independent review found in the prior head (PR #779, 9c96fd069565dc9932541866749e441d8d7d0a94): (1) `if:` guards compared the boolean workshop_persistence_only input to the string 'true', which GitHub Actions coerces via mismatched-type numeric comparison, making the guard always take the full-journey branch; (2) failed-step evidence captured the raw caught error (error.message / String(error)) and rethrew it, which could leak DEV_LOGIN_CLIENT_SECRET into JSON/reporter output on a password-fill failure; (3) captureVersionPair only checked deployment.json's FE commit and the live /bff/version BFF SHA, never deployment.json's own bffCommit/bffSourceCommitSha field; (4) the actions/checkout pin was a 41-character string, one character longer than a valid SHA; (5) the saved-title assertions targeted a workshop-item-<id> locator on the detail route, but that testid only exists in WorkshopListView -- the detail route (StrategyWorkshopPage with an id) renders WorkshopSessionView, which has no such locator.

acceptance_mapping.AC1_optional_workflow_scope: Added `workshop_persistence_only` boolean input (default false) to .github/workflows/pfg-agora-journey-e2e-hosted-acceptance.yml. Default full journey step (agora-product-journey.spec.ts) and its identity/safety guard steps (Reject unsafe target..., Bind expected identity...) are unchanged and still run unconditionally except the viewer-secret precondition, which is skipped only in focused mode alongside the viewer bearer mint step it protects.
acceptance_mapping.AC2_real_account_password_login: e2e/workshop-persistence-hosted.spec.ts's realUiDevLogin() drives the real #dev-account/#dev-password form rendered by src/pages/Auth.tsx (confirmed by reading Auth.tsx:227-274 and devLogin.ts, which posts DEV_LOGIN_CLIENT_ID/SECRET as client_id/client_secret with credentials:'include', establishing a real HttpOnly BFF session cookie). No bearer token is ever injected via addInitScript/page.route, and no storageState is used anywhere in the spec (verified by src/test/workshop-persistence-hosted-policy.test.ts's source-contract assertions).
acceptance_mapping.AC3_single_workshop_create_and_readback: The spec's create_workshop step submits exactly one uniquely titled workshop (`Workshop persistence journey <uuid>`) through the real UI form and captures the real POST /bff/agora/workshops receipt. assert_saved_title_ui now calls assertSavedTitleViaListRoundTrip(), which follows the real detail-route backlink ('工坊列表') back to WorkshopListView, asserts the visible workshop-item-<id> row contains the exact saved title there (the only route where that locator exists), then clicks the same real item to reopen the matching detail id. Server readback (GET /bff/agora/workshops/<id>) is a separate step. No reconstruction, research, Trading Room, or consultation flow is invoked.
acceptance_mapping.AC4_real_signout_and_fresh_login_readbac: realUiSignOut() clicks the real 'Sign out' UI control and asserts the underlying POST /bff/logout succeeds; assertSessionInvalidated() then confirms GET /bff/me returns 401 with no Authorization header (server-side invalidation, not just client-side state). The test then closes the first BrowserContext, opens a brand-new context (assertAnonymousContext confirms it redirects to /auth?reason=auth-required), performs a second real UI login with the same DEV_LOGIN_CLIENT_ID/SECRET (same account/tenant), and calls reopenWorkshopFromListAndAssertTitle(), which reads the exact saved title from the post-login list route's workshop-item-<id> row and clicks it to reopen the same workshop id's detail route.
acceptance_mapping.AC5_exact_pair_before_and_after: captureVersionPair() is called once before the login sequence and once after the fresh-login readback. Each call now asserts three independent sources against the expected exact pair: deployment.json's FE commit, deployment.json's own bffCommit/bffSourceCommitSha (the manifest's BFF claim, previously unchecked), and bff/version's live source_commit_sha -- all three must equal EXPECTED_FE_SHA/EXPECTED_BFF_SHA. The test's finally block additionally recomputes `matched` from the two captures and fails the test (even after all steps otherwise passed) if the pair does not match on both sides.
acceptance_mapping.AC6_sanitized_evidence_only: writeEvidence() persists only schema_version, task_id, operation_id, timestamps, status, the version pair (fe/bff sha + captured_at, no tokens), workshop id/title/title_sha256, and a per-step {id, status} list. runStep()'s catch path never reads the caught error's message/cause -- it discards the thrown value entirely (`catch {}`) and writes only a fixed `step "<id>" failed` string plus the step id, then throws a new generic Error carrying no original text, so a secret-bearing form-fill or request failure cannot reach the JSON evidence file or the Playwright reporter. The spec never calls page.screenshot(), never reads cookies()/request().headers(), and Playwright's own artifact capture is disabled workflow-wide by PANTHEON_CREDENTIALED_PLAYWRIGHT_NO_ARTIFACTS=1 (trace/screenshot/video all 'off' in playwright.config.ts).
acceptance_mapping.AC7_focused_mode_scope_and_tokens: The two 'Mint a short-lived operator/viewer bearer token' workflow steps and the full-journey step are gated with `if: "!inputs.workshop_persistence_only"` (boolean negation, not a string comparison); the focused step is gated with `if: inputs.workshop_persistence_only` (boolean truthiness). workshop_persistence_only is a `type: boolean` workflow_dispatch input, so `inputs.workshop_persistence_only` is already a boolean in an `if:` expression -- comparing it to the string 'true' (the prior, defective form) forces GitHub Actions' mismatched-type numeric coercion, where the string side becomes NaN and `!= 'true'` is therefore always true regardless of the actual input. That defect made focused dispatch always execute the full-journey/token-mint steps while never running the focused spec; the boolean-native guards fix both branches. Default (unset/false) input keeps every existing full-mode step running exactly as before, and `true` now correctly runs only the focused spec. DEV_LOGIN_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are the same existing secret-bound env vars already used by the full journey; no new secret or credential flow was added.
acceptance_mapping.AC8_discovery_and_policy_validation: Playwright test discovery (`npx playwright test e2e/workshop-persistence-hosted.spec.ts --list`) finds exactly 1 test. src/test/workshop-persistence-hosted-policy.test.ts is LOCAL, deterministic source-contract validation (17 assertions covering both the spec and workflow source, including dedicated assertions for the boolean-guard fix, the manifest BFF SHA check, the generic-failure-message fix with a synthetic secret-bearing-error proof, and the checkout pin length) and is explicitly documented in both files as local validation, distinct from the HOSTED ACCEPTANCE run performed by the workflow itself against a live deployment.

local_validation.not_run: The hosted browser journey itself (WORKSHOP_PERSISTENCE_HOSTED_E2E=1 against a live Pantheon dev deployment) was not run by this task; it requires workflow_dispatch with the workshop_persistence_only input against a real deployed FE/BFF pair and real DEV_LOGIN_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, which is out of this source-only task's scope per the task brief's coordinator note. These are source-string/local checks and do not themselves establish runtime correctness against a live deployment; the corrected boolean guards, manifest SHA check, sanitized-failure path, and list round-trip navigation still require hosted execution to prove end-to-end.
local_validation.prior_review_reject: Independent review of PR #779 head 9c96fd069565dc9932541866749e441d8d7d0a94 (frozen evidence blob b791057d5e40fee2671d0ce2e76773c6f8213729) rejected on the five defects described in `note` above. This revision repairs all five in the same three source files without changing product UI.

not_changed: e2e/agora-product-journey.spec.ts and its default full-journey workflow steps are untouched other than being wrapped in the new focused-mode `if:` guard, which evaluates to run exactly as before when workshop_persistence_only is unset/false.
No new secrets, credential flows, or runner frameworks were introduced.
No product UI (WorkshopListView / WorkshopSessionView) was changed; only the spec's navigation was corrected to match existing real locators.
